newsitem.title: HONG KONG: FedEx plans medicine relief flight to China.
newsitem.headline: FedEx plans medicine relief flight to China.

text.p: Federal Express workers are arranging a charity airlift of medical supplies from the United States to China, the airline's Asia Pacific public relations manager, David Clarke, said.

Using one of its DC-10 freighters, Fedex will fly around 50 tonnes of pharmaceuticals donated by U.S. drugs manufacturers from a collection point in Indianapolis to the airline's Asian hub at Subic Bay.
The aid will be flown to Chengdu in China's rural Sichuan province on April 14 for distribution.
The flight has been organised by the U.S.-based charity Heart to Heart International which has also enlisted the help of other major U.S. sponsors including Chrysler and McDonnell Douglas.
Fedex helped organise similar relief flights to Vietnam and Calcutta in India over the past two years, Clarke said. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+5017
